description:
Running sheets the bone of the blade on the back builds the weight capacity up to 400lbs, strength, and solidness. High around and low in the center with empty openings configuration forestalls water and residue amassing viably.
Features
Easy access. If you own a raised vehicle such as an SUV, Jeep, or truck, installing running boards is imperative. Not only do they make it easier for you to get on and off your vehicle, but their lower steps also help to provide some boost to kids and elderly passengers who might be having some mobility issues.
Protection Against Debris. When you are driving, car tires often shoot various road debris (such as small rocks, gravel and nails) onto the side panels and windows of the car. At this time, the running boards will protect your body and reduce scratches.
Keep Interior Clean. passengers can step on running boards and wipe dirt off their feet before getting on.
Enhances Appearance. Running boards are among the few aftermarket accessories that completely transform the appearance of your truck. With a set for both sides, your truck will have a whole new look that will catch the attention and the eyes of any car enthusiast.
Resale value. Running boards can help to increase your truck’s resale value, which will improve your chances of landing a willing buyer.
1-year warranty. For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Fitment
Compatible with 2019-2026 Chevy Silverado/GMC Sierra 1500 Crew Cab.

highlights: Heavy-Duty Support: Reinforced steel construction supports up to 400 lbs, delivering solid, stable footing for everyday use.
Open Design, Less Buildup: The raised-and-lowered profile with open sections helps shed water and dirt, reducing buildup on the running boards.
Step Up with Confidence: Provides a convenient step for easier entry and exit while helping keep mud, snow, and road debris away from your vehicle.
